newsitem.title: GERMANY: MAN Roland sees smaller 1996/97 loss.
newsitem.headline: MAN Roland sees smaller 1996/97 loss.

text.p: MAN Roland AG, the printing machinery unit of MAN AG, should be able to report a smaller loss in the 1996/97 business year, chairman Peter Bruett said on Thursday.
Speaking at the company's annual general meeting, Bruett said a more secure order situation in rotary-printing equipment should help the firm's earnings.
"I am confident that we will earn an appropriate profit again in the future," Bruett said.
MAN Roland reported in October a group net loss of 81 million marks for the 1995/96 year, less than a 145.7 million marks loss the year before.
